                                                  direct_text: Fixed a kubelet device manager bug where topology hint computation enumerated O(2^n) NUMA node combinations using all machine NUMA nodes.                                                   subtree_text: Fixed a kubelet device manager bug where topology hint computation enumerated O(2^n) NUMA node combinations using all machine NUMA nodes. On systems with many NUMA nodes that carry no devices (e.g. NVIDIA GB200 with 36 NUMA nodes), this caused kubelet to stall indefinitely during pod admission. The device manager now restricts iteration to NUMA nodes that actually host devices for the requested resource, reducing the search space to O(2^k) where k is typically 1–2. ( #138244 , @fanzhangio ) [SIG
